scope: The twelve edited data shards retain existing CC BY-SA 4.0 rights. The new type vocabulary and editorial correction ledger are original GitWorld metadata under CC BY-SA 4.0. The edited original base fields.json remains Apache-2.0. No source/assertion record or raw-work permission is changed.
changes: Reclassified exactly 98 source grouping objects, across all 196 object copies in twelve shards, from office to source-tenure-scope.
Kept every object ID, identity, label, description and alias; kept all 3935 assertions and 18 source records exactly.
Narrowed only the base office type label and its existing binding:historical-type controlled-value display to Office / 官职.

Added the bilingual Source table grouping / 来源年表分组 display for gitworld:source-tenure-scope and a hash-bound modern classification ledger. The grouping follows the source table and does not establish an office, polity or territory; no historical event or source record was created.
